name: must / mustn't
summary: Must va mustn't modal fe'llari qoidalar, majburiyatlar va taqiqlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: Shaxsiy bo'lmagan qoidalar va qonun-qoidalarni aytish uchun must ishlatiladi.

example.en: You must wear a helmet when riding a bike.

usage.text: Qat'iy majburiyatlarni bildirish uchun ham must ishlatiladi.

example.en: I must finish my homework tonight.
example.uz: Men bugun kechqurun uy vazifamni tugatishim kerak.

usage.text: Biror narsani qilish qat'iyan taqiqlanganligini bildirish uchun mustn't ishlatiladi.

example.en: You mustn't use your phone during the exam.
You must be quiet.
You mustn't touch that.
Must we stay here?

structure.formula: Yes, subject + must / No, subject + mustn't

example.en: Yes, you must. / No, you mustn't.

tip: Eslatma: Mustn't - taqiqni bildiradi ('qilish mumkin emas'), 'majbur emasman' degani emas!

name: needn't / don't have to
summary: Needn't va don't have to biror harakatni bajarish majburiy emasligini, ya'ni xohishga ko'ra ekanligini bildiradi.

usage.text: Biror ishni qilish shart emasligini, lekin xohlasa qilish mumkinligini aytish uchun don't have to ishlatiladi.

example.en: You don't have to wear a tie to the party.

usage.text: Hozirda buni qilishga hojat yo'qligini bildirish uchun needn't ishlatiladi.

example.en: You needn't buy milk; we already have plenty.
example.uz: Sotib olishingiz shart emas; bizda allaqachon sut ko'p.

usage.text: Vaqtni behuda sarflamaslik kerakligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

example.en: We don't have to hurry, we have lots of time.

structure.formula: Subject + don't / doesn't have to + V1

example.en: He doesn't have to get up early today.
example.uz: U bugun erta turishi shart emas.

example.en: You needn't worry about it.

structure.formula: Subject + must / have to (doesn't apply as negative structure)

example.en: I don't have to go.

structure.formula: Do/Does + subject + have to...? Yes, I do / No, I don't

example.en: Do I have to go? No, you don't.
example.uz: Men borishim shartmi? Yo'q, shart emas.

tip: Eslatma: 'Don't have to' va 'needn't' ma'nosi bir xil, lekin 'don't have to' kundalik nutqda ko'proq ishlatiladi.

name: have to
summary: Have to tashqi qoidalar yoki boshqalar tomonidan yuklatilgan majburiyatlarni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

usage.text: Maktab yoki ish joyi qoidalariga bo'ysunishni tushuntirish uchun ishlatiladi.

example.en: We have to wear a school uniform.

usage.text: Boshqa birovning talabiga ko'ra bajariladigan ishlar uchun ishlatiladi.

example.en: My mom says I have to clean my room.

usage.text: O'tgan zamondagi majburiyatlarni ifodalash uchun had to ishlatiladi.

example.en: I had to stay at home yesterday.

structure.formula: Subject + have to / has to + V1

example.en: She has to study for the test.

structure.formula: Subject + don't / doesn't have to + V1

example.en: We don't have to work on Sundays.
example.uz: Biz yakshanba kunlari ishlashimiz shart emas.

structure.formula: Do / Does + subject + have to + V1?

example.en: Do you have to leave now?

structure.formula: Yes, I do / No, I don't

example.en: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

tip: Eslatma: Uchinchi shaxs birlikda (he, she, it) 'has to' ishlatilishini unutmang!
